text_block_list.text:
Each day was jam-packed with<n>activity, yet
somehow it feels like<n>summer camp went by in the
blink of<n>an eye.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Grass! Race ya to the BUUUS!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, I'm on my way!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What in the heavens has gotten into<n>her? She's
been pestering me so<n>much lately.
choice_data_list: Maybe she's excited for the upcoming race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that's fair. While you may<n>not see me
hollering wildly about the<n>flames of passion...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I too have no intention of<n>surrendering the lead to
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Not until I reach the destination I seek.
